heading: Making AI more loving - AI characters co-creation platform integrating LLMs and affective computing.

blocks.html:
CONCH. AI ( Ionic tech ↗︎ ) is a product based on Large Language Models (LLMs) and affective computing, designed

to offer users more emotional value beyond efficiency through AI. Creators can create personalized AI characters and earn income when other users interact with the characters they've created. When I joined the team, there was already an initial product. Before launching an overseas APP version, many features still require further refinement.
